description.value: Asian Fiesta is a Chinese fast-food restaurant located in a strip mall in Fort St. John, serving a broad menu of Cantonese-style dishes including chow mein, fried rice, ginger beef, and crispy fried chicken. The restaurant offers both local delivery and pickup ordering through its own website. With over 100 customer reviews and a full online menu, it is a well-established quick-service option for cyclists passing through this northern BC hub.

address.value: 9600 93 Avenue, Unit 1530, Fort St. John, BC V1J 5Z2
